scripts.text:
[La Ed]
There MUST be a treasure hidden in that place!
scripts.translation:
[拉·埃德]
那个地方一定藏着宝藏！

scripts.text:
[Haith]
If we find it, people will no longer think we're losers~!!
scripts.translation:
[海斯]
如果我们找到了，大家就不会再觉得我们是失败者了~!!

scripts.text:
[La Ed]
Finally!
scripts.translation:
[拉·埃德]
终于！

scripts.text:
[Haith]
Let's go find that treasure!
scripts.translation:
[海斯]
我们出发去找那个宝藏吧！

scripts.text:
[La Ed]
Let's do it~ !!
scripts.translation:
[拉·埃德]
走起~ !!

scripts.text:
[La Ed]
By the way...do you think he
would tell us about such a
great treasure so easily?
scripts.translation:
[拉·埃德]
话说回来...你觉得他会这么轻易地
就把这么伟大的宝藏告诉我们吗？

scripts.text: Hm? What treasure?
scripts.translation: 嗯？什么宝藏？

scripts.text:
[La Ed]
Wha--?! when did you start listening to us?!
scripts.translation:
[拉·埃德]
什--？！你什么时候开始偷听我们的？！

scripts.text:
[Haith]
Huh...seems like you wanna know
more about the treasure. Well,
this information doesn't come cheap...
scripts.translation:
[海斯]
呵...看来你想了解更多关于宝藏的事呢。
好吧，这情报可不是免费的...

scripts.text:
[La Ed]
Plus, we'll need a little
a little something in case
*cough!* ^555555we don't find
anything at all.^000000
scripts.translation:
[拉·埃德]
而且，我们还需要准备一点点
一点点小东西，以防万一
*咳咳!* ^555555如果我们最后什么也没找到。^000000

scripts.text:
[La Ed, Haith]
If you pay us 1,000 zeny, we will tell you!
scripts.translation:
[拉·埃德, 海斯]
如果你付我们1,000 泽尼，我们就告诉你！

scripts.text: Pay 1,000 zeny
scripts.translation: 支付1,000 泽尼

scripts.text: Refuse to pay
scripts.translation: 拒绝支付

scripts.text:
[Haith]
Hahahaha! You the man!
scripts.translation:
[海斯]
哈哈哈哈！够爽快！

scripts.text:
[La Ed]
Okay, not too long ago, a famous
adventurer named Niels came back from his travels.
scripts.translation:
[拉·埃德]
好吧，不久前，一位名叫尼尔斯的著名冒险家从旅行中回来了。

scripts.text:
[Haith]
*Whispers*
^555555He brought a big box with him.^000000
scripts.translation:
[海斯]
*小声说*
^555555他随身带着一个大箱子。^000000

scripts.text:
[La Ed]
Also, he came back in the middle
of the night without telling
anyone. So, of course he's got
some secret, don't you think?
scripts.translation:
[拉·埃德]
而且，他是在半夜没告诉任何人就回来的。
所以，他肯定有什么秘密，你不觉得吗？

scripts.text:
[Haith]
What could be inside that box~?
It just has to be treasure!!
scripts.translation:
[海斯]
那个箱子里会是什么呢~？
肯定就是宝藏！！

scripts.text:
[La Ed]
So! We decided to go on a journey to find treasure of our own-!!
scripts.translation:
[拉·埃德]
所以！我们决定踏上旅程，去寻找属于我们自己的宝藏——！！

scripts.text:
[Haith]
The problem is, we are not sure
whether or not Niels would tell
us the location of where he
found the treasure...
scripts.translation:
[海斯]
问题在于，我们不确定
尼尔斯是否愿意告诉我们
他发现宝藏的具体位置……

scripts.text:
[La Ed]
Because Niels always treat us like
we're stupid!! Bah~!!
scripts.translation:
[拉·埃德]
因为尼尔斯总是把我们
当成笨蛋！！呸~!!

scripts.text: Where is this Niels person?
scripts.translation: 那个叫尼尔斯的人在哪？

scripts.text:
[La Ed]
He's staying at the northern part
of this village.
scripts.translation:
[拉·埃德]
他住在村子的北边。

scripts.text:
[Haith]
Since we gave you good information,
we expect that you pay us back!
scripts.translation:
[海斯]
既然我们提供了有用的情报，
我们就希望你能作为回报！

scripts.text:
[La Ed, Haith]
Good luck!
scripts.translation:
[拉·埃德, 海斯]
祝你好运！

scripts.text:
[La Ed]
Oh well~! If you don't have the money, then we can't give you the information~
scripts.translation:
[拉·埃德]
好吧~！如果你没钱，那我们就没法把情报告诉你~

scripts.text:
[Haith]
Bah! Whatever~
scripts.translation:
[海斯]
呸！随你的便吧~

scripts.text:
[Iriya]
Mr. Niels is at the table in the
corner. He has many interesting
stories about the world.
scripts.translation:
[伊莉娅]
尼尔斯先生就在角落的桌子旁。
他有很多关于世界的有趣故事。

scripts.text:
[Iriya]
I am not sure where he has been
this time. He just laughs and
says 'I don't think I am fit
for this teaching job.'
scripts.translation:
[伊莉娅]
我不确定这次他去了哪里。
他只是笑着说：“我觉得我不适合当老师。”

scripts.text:
[Iriya]
In the meantime, people keep
visiting Mr. Niels... and I
can't help but wonder...
Where has he gone?
scripts.translation:
[伊莉娅]
与此同时，人们一直络绎不绝地
拜访尼尔斯先生……我不禁在想……
他到底去了哪里？

scripts.text:
[Niels]
Hmm? What's that look for?
Ah~ You must of heard the rumors
of me finding some kind of
treasure. Yeah, that's understandable...
scripts.translation:
[尼尔斯]
嗯？你那是什么眼神？
啊~ 你一定是听到了我发现某种
宝藏的传闻吧。也是，这可以理解……

scripts.text:
[Niels]
Well, those rumors of me stumbling
on some wonderful treasure is
just the result of overactive
imaginations. All I've found
was a little something to add
to my collection.
scripts.translation:
[尼尔斯]
哎呀，那些关于我偶然发现
某种奇妙宝藏的传闻，
不过是大家想象力过于丰富的结果罢了。
我发现的只不过是能为我的收藏
增添一点小东西而已。

scripts.text:
[Niels]
But...since I've proven to myself
that 'it' actually exists by
seeing it with my own eyes,
to me, what I've obtained is a
valuable treasure.
scripts.translation:
[尼尔斯]
但是……既然我已经亲眼见到了“它”，
向自己证明了“它”确实存在，
那么对我来说，我所获得的就是
一份珍贵的宝藏。

scripts.text:
[Niels]
This village of Comodo!
Don't you think the caves are too
small and narrow for some reason?
scripts.translation:
[尼尔斯]
这个克魔岛村庄！
你不觉得那些洞穴因为某种原因
显得太小、太狭窄了吗？

scripts.text:
[Niels]
So I was thinking about it...
And I came to the conclusion that
there should be something hidden
inside the cave...
scripts.translation:
[尼尔斯]
所以我一直在思考这件事……
最后我得出了一个结论，
那就是洞穴内部一定隐藏着什么……

scripts.text:
[Niels]
And then!
I finally found it.
The patch to 'the place'
that no one has ever found!
scripts.translation:
[尼尔斯]
然后！
我终于找到了。
找到了那个从未有人发现过的
“那个地方”的入口！

scripts.text:
[Niels]
.......Hm?

[Niels]
I was expecting a spectacular and
rather dramatic sound effect
for my declaration!
Eh, oh well...
scripts.translation:
[尼尔斯]
我本以为在宣布这件事时，
会有某种壮观又富有戏剧性的音效呢！
唉，算了……

scripts.text:
[Niels]
Well, in the spirit of discovery,
don't ever think of asking me
about directions to 'the place'
or about what is in 'the place.'
I wouldn't want to spoil the
surprise.
scripts.translation:
[尼尔斯]
既然是为了探索的精神，
千万别想着问我关于“那个地方”
的路线，或者“那个地方”里
有什么。我可不想破坏了
这份惊喜。

scripts.text:
[Niels]
If you're a real adventurer,
I expect you to scream at the
top of your lungs...
scripts.translation:
[尼尔斯]
如果你是个真正的冒险者，
我期待你会用尽全身力气大喊……

scripts.text:
[Niels]
'Ahhhh! I need to know what it
is!!' Kick the door open and run
like hell to find this place on
your own!!
scripts.translation:
[尼尔斯]
“啊啊啊！我一定要知道
那到底是什么！！”去踢开那扇门，
然后拼命奔跑，靠你自己
去找到那个地方！！

scripts.text:
[Niels]
Now! Hurry and seek this place
out! Will this place be a totally
new world, or will it be a trap
to hell?! Go forth, meet your
destiny, adventurer!
scripts.translation:
[尼尔斯]
现在！快去寻找那个地方吧！
那里会是一个全新的世界，
还是通往地狱的陷阱？！
前进吧，去迎接你的命运，冒险者！

I am sorry, but I cannot play with
you right now. My parent's house
was struck by lightning yesterday
and it burned down our roof...
scripts.translation:

……*唉*
很抱歉，我现在没法陪你玩。
我父母的房子昨天被雷劈了，
把屋顶都给烧毁了……

scripts.text:
[Haatan]
 . . . !

[Haatan]
Oh yes! Could you help me?
You look pretty well off...
Can donate some money for
re-constructing my parents' house?
You Rune-Midgartsians are all
richer than Utans! I beg you!
scripts.translation:
[哈坦]
噢对了！你能帮帮我吗？
你看上去挺有钱的……
能不能捐点钱帮我重建
我父母的房子？你们鲁尼米特加特人
都比乌坦人富有！拜托你了！

Thank you so much!
scripts.translation:

非常感谢你！

scripts.translation:

却还要装作有的样子？！
我最讨厌对我撒谎的人了！！

scripts.text:
[Pasto]
Oh my god~! Finally,
another Rune-Midgartsian!
I've never seen anyone from
home in this place before!
Nice to meet you, my name is Pasto!
scripts.translation:
[帕斯托]
我的天呐~！终于，
又一个鲁恩米德加茨人！
我以前从未在这个地方
见过家乡的人！
很高兴认识你，我叫帕斯托！

scripts.text:
[Pasto]
This place is called Umbala.
The local people in this village
have formed a culture that's
totally different from other
places I've been.
scripts.translation:
[帕斯托]
这个地方叫做汶巴拉。
这个村庄的当地人
形成了一种与我所去过的
其他地方完全不同的文化。

scripts.text:
[Pasto]
I guess it's because this
place has been isolated from
other regions because of its
geographical features.
scripts.translation:
[帕斯托]
我想这是因为这里的
地理特征导致它与
其他地区隔绝了。

scripts.text:
[Pasto]
They look different from us, and
use a language that is still very
confusing to me. I was also
confounded by their different use
of facial expression.
scripts.translation:
[帕斯托]
他们的长相与我们不同，
使用的语言对我来说也
非常令人困惑。我也被他们
迥异的面部表情搞得晕头转向。

scripts.text:
[Pasto]
Of course, there are some
similarities. However, you might
want to be careful about certain
issues.
scripts.translation:
[帕斯托]
当然，也有一些相似之处。
不过，你可能需要注意
某些问题。

scripts.text:
[Pasto]
Sometimes, what you say or do
or do could be misinterpreted as
having the totally opposite meaning.
scripts.translation:
[帕斯托]
有时候，你所说的话或所做的事，可能会被误解为完全相反的意思。

scripts.text:
[Pasto]
I wish I could speak their
language...*Sigh*
...Or I wish I could meet more
people here that speak my
language...I...I'm...
So very lonely...*Sob*
scripts.translation:
[帕斯托]
我真希望我会说他们的语言……*唉*
……或者我真希望在这里能遇到更多说我语言的人……我……我……
真的好孤独……*呜咽*

scripts.text:
[Yuwooki]
Umbah umbah woogawoo...
oops, sorry! I'm so used
to speaking in Utan by now.
It's a pleasure to meet you.
scripts.translation:
[尤乌基]
Umbah umbah woogawoo……
哎呀，抱歉！我已经习惯说乌坦语了。
很高兴见到你。

scripts.text:
[Yuwooki]
I never imagined that I would
meet another person from
the homeland in this village.
Hahahahah~!
scripts.translation:
[尤乌基]
我从未想过会在这个村子里遇到另一个来自家乡的人。
哈哈哈哈哈哈~！

scripts.text:
[Yuwooki]
I came here to seek strong people
to help me master my fighting
skills. But I was soon frustrated
because it took me a long
time to learn the language...
scripts.translation:
[尤乌基]
我来这里是为了寻找强者，帮助我精进战斗技巧。但我很快就感到很沮丧，因为我花了很长时间才学会这里的语言……

scripts.text:
[Yuwooki]
Well, now I am kind of used to my
circumstances. Even though it
took me a while to used to
Utan culture. Hahahaha~!
scripts.translation:
[尤乌基]
好吧，现在我已经有点习惯这里的生活了。虽然花了一段时间才适应乌坦文化。哈哈哈哈~！

scripts.text:
[Yuwooki]
But you know what was the weirdest
thing I found out about Utan
culture? At first the Utan men
seemed to have, shall we say, a
strong species preservation instinct.
scripts.translation:
[尤乌基]
但你知道我在乌坦文化中发现的最奇怪的事情是什么吗？起初，乌坦男人似乎有着，该怎么说呢，非常强烈的种族延续本能。

scripts.text:
[Yuwooki]
There are many Utan playboys in
this village. Some may think
the Utans are primitive in
this respect, but...
scripts.translation:
[尤乌基]
这个村子里有很多乌坦花花公子。有些人可能会认为乌坦人在这方面很原始，但是……

scripts.text:
[Yuwooki]
As I learned more about them,
I eventually realized that their
courtship rituals are actually
more advanced than anything the
Rune-Midgarts culture has to offer.
scripts.translation:
[尤乌基]
随着我对他们的了解加深，我最终意识到，他们的求爱仪式实际上比卢恩·米德加兹的任何文化都要先进。

scripts.text:
[Yuwooki]
It's really quite fascinating.
I'm actually still learning
quite much from the Utan
playboys and their awesome methods.
scripts.translation:
[尤乌基]
这真的非常迷人。实际上我还在从那些乌坦花花公子及其了不起的手段中学习很多东西。

scripts.text:
[Jertan]
Bungee jumping can be dangerous,
and you can risk your life doing
it. We Utans have consider
bungee jumping an important
part of the ceremony of
becoming an adult.
scripts.translation:
[杰尔坦]
蹦极是很危险的，可能会让你丢掉性命。我们乌坦人一直将蹦极视为成年仪式中重要的一部分。

Woo umbaumbaumbabah woo humbah
Umbababah umba umba.
scripts.translation:

scripts.text:
[Arotan]
Completing the bungee jump
is very difficult to do.
Today, we are here in celebration
of the people that made it and
have shown their courage.
scripts.translation:
[阿罗坦]
完成蹦极是非常困难的。
今天，我们聚集在这里，庆祝那些成功完成挑战并展现出勇气的人们。

scripts.text:
[Klumatan]
It's really scary, falling from
such a high place...
But I guess you have to do it,
otherwise no one will ever
consider you a grownup.
scripts.translation:
[克卢马坦]
从那么高的地方掉下来真的很可怕……
但我猜你必须得这么做，否则没人会把你当成大人。

scripts.text:
[Klumatan]
I guess I don't want to
be a grownup right away.
But some kids my age are
in too big of a hurry
to not be kids anymore.
scripts.translation:
[克卢马坦]
我想我并不想马上就成为大人。
但有些和我同龄的孩子已经迫不及待地想不再当小孩了。

scripts.text:
[Bertan]
What up, loser!
scripts.translation:
[贝尔坦]
哟，失败者！

scripts.text:
[Bertan]
What's the matter,
ya big Rune-Midgartsian?!?!
I just called you a 'loser!'
I guess you're too stupid
to understand!!
Hahahahahahaahahhahaha~!
scripts.translation:
[贝尔坦]
怎么了，你这个大卢恩·米德加兹人！？！？
我刚才叫你“失败者”！
我想你一定是太蠢了才听不懂！！
哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈~！

scripts.text:
[Bertan]
...
Uh...oh!

[Bertan]
It looks like you can understand
me--! Good job, good job!
Alright, by way of apology,
do you want to hear a joke?
scripts.translation:
[贝尔坦]
看来你能听懂我说话——！
干得好，干得好！
好吧，作为道歉，
你想听个笑话吗？

scripts.text:
[Bertan]
Alright, alright.
Here we go.
Ummmm...
Alright, I got one.
scripts.translation:
[贝尔坦]
好吧，好吧。
来了来了。
唔唔唔...
好了，我想到了一个。

scripts.text:
[Bertan]
What did the Rune-Midgartsian
say to the Savage?
...
scripts.translation:
[贝尔坦]
鲁恩米德加茨人对
野猪说了什么？
...

scripts.text:
[Bertan]
I don't know...
But they didn't have any
trouble understanding
each other!!! HAHAHAHA~!
Get it? 'Cuz, like,
they're both pigs~!
scripts.translation:
[贝尔坦]
我也不知道...
但他们完全没有
沟通障碍！！！
哈哈哈~！
懂了吗？因为，就像，
他们两个都是猪嘛~！

scripts.text:
[Bertan]
Not funny, huh?
Oh well. I guess my
sense of humor is just
too sophisticated.
scripts.translation:
[贝尔坦]
不好笑吗？
好吧。我想我的
幽默感可能实在
太高级了。

scripts.text:
[Bertan]
Okay...what's the best
way to tame an Orc Lady?
Give up..?
scripts.translation:
[贝尔坦]
好吧...驯服兽人女子
最好的方法是什么？
放弃试试？

scripts.text:
[Bertan]
With a wedding ring!
HAHAHAHAHAHAHHA!
Oh God~ I'm hilarious!!
scripts.translation:
[贝尔坦]
用结婚戒指！
哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈！
天呐~ 我真是个天才！！

scripts.text:
[Bertan]
...
...Wait.
Wait a minute...
scripts.translation:
[贝尔坦]
...
...等等。
等一下...

scripts.text:
[Bertan]
That's not even funny...
Just incredibly...
Scary...
Brrr--!
She's hideous!!
scripts.translation:
[贝尔坦]
这根本一点都不好笑...
简直是...
太恐怖了...
呜呜——！
她长得太丑了！！

scripts.text:
[Bertan]
Actually...forget it.
scripts.translation:
[贝尔坦]
算了...忘了吧。

scripts.text:
[Bertan]
I was going to say a
knock knock joke about
Isis, but then decided
that kind of humor is
too low brow.
...Zing!
scripts.translation:
[贝尔坦]
我本来想讲一个关于
蛇女伊丝的敲门笑话，
但后来觉得那种幽默感
太低俗了。
...嘿！

scripts.text:
[Bertan]
Why are Rune-Midgartsians
SOOoOOoo...
Um, hmmmmm.
Maybe that joke
isn't so good for this
situation, yeah?
scripts.translation:
[贝尔坦]
为什么鲁恩米德加茨人
都那么——...
嗯，唔唔唔。
也许这个笑话不太适合
现在的场合，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Bertan]
Okay, why is it that
GMs prefer not to be
seen...? Give up?
scripts.translation:
[贝尔坦]
好吧，为什么
GM们都不喜欢
露面呢...？放弃试试？

scripts.text:
[Bertan]
BECAUSE THOSE GUYS WEAR
SKIRTS ~! HAHAHA!
OH MAN, I MADE A FUNNY!
scripts.translation:
[贝尔坦]
因为那些家伙都
穿着裙子 ~！
哈哈哈！
噢天呐，我讲了个好笑的！

scripts.text:
[Bertan]
*Whew* Yowza~
Oh, man.
Utterly classic.
scripts.translation:
[贝尔坦]
*呼* 哇哦~
噢，天呐。
真是经典中的经典。

scripts.text:
[Bertan]
A Crusader, an Alchemist and a Novice walk into a bar.
scripts.translation:
[贝尔坦]
一名十字军、一名炼金术士
和一名初心者走进了一家酒吧。

scripts.text:
[Bertan]
Inside, they see a sign that
says '^CC0000Monster Help Agency:
LADIES ONLY.^000000'
scripts.translation:
[贝尔坦]
在里面，他们看到一个牌子，
上面写着 '^CC0000怪物求助中心：
仅限女士。^000000'

scripts.text:
[Bertan]
'^000099Oh!^000000' says the Crusader.
'^000099It's a lucky thing we are
all ladies.^000000' She goes up
and says '^000099Gimmie a ride.^000000'
Kinda rude for a Crusader,
but whatever.
scripts.translation:
[贝尔坦]
'^000099噢！^000000' 十字军说道。
'^000099幸好我们
全都是女士。^000000' 她走上前去
说道 '^000099载我一程。^000000'
对十字军来说有点没礼貌，
不过随它去吧。

scripts.text:
[Bertan]
Out of nowhere, this
Grand PecoPeco appears
and is all '^CC0000I'll give you
a ride, baby. Careful, this
road can get buuuuumpy.^000000'
And then they're off.
scripts.translation:
[贝尔坦]
突然间，一只
巨大的大嘴鸟出现了，
说着 '^CC0000宝贝，我载你一程。
小心点，这条路可能会很颠簸。^000000'
然后它们就出发了。

scripts.text:
[Bertan]
Next comes the Alchemist
and she's like '^330099I need
help killing Zombies^000000' and
then this Marine Sphere
comes from out of
nowhere and is all...
scripts.translation:
[贝尔坦]
接下来是炼金术士，
她说 '^330099我需要
帮忙杀腐尸^000000'，
然后这只气泡虫
不知从哪里冒了出来，
说着...

scripts.text:
[Bertan]
'^CC0000I got your fire. Careful
baby, touch me the wrong
way and I might just
exploooode.^000000' So then
they're off on their
merry way too.
scripts.translation:
[贝尔坦]
'^CC0000我感受到你的热情了。小心
点，宝贝，要是碰错地方了
我可能会直接炸
裂开哦。^000000' 于是他们也
兴高采烈地出发了。

scripts.text:
[Bertan]
Finally, the Novice
comes up and says
'^006633I need someone to
party with.^000000'
scripts.translation:
[贝尔坦]
终于，那个初心者
走过来说道：
'^006633我想找人组队。^000000'

scripts.text:
[Bertan]
Out of nowhere, this
Hode pops up and says...
scripts.translation:
[贝尔坦]
突然间，一只蚯蚓
冒了出来，说道……

scripts.text:
[Bertan]
'^CC0000I know some people
but let me check my
Rolodex. HODE on!^000000'
....
scripts.translation:
[贝尔坦]
'^CC0000我认识一些人，
不过让我查查我的
通讯录。蚯蚓上线！^000000'
……

scripts.text:
[Bertan]
Well, come on!
I can't be funny
all the time, you know?
scripts.translation:
[贝尔坦]
喂，别这样嘛！
我总不能一直
讲笑话吧？

[Boorkatan]
Huh? You're from Rune-Midgarts,
aren't you? Have you ever been bungee jumping?

[布尔卡坦]

Okay, I'll take your word for

scripts.translation:

哇，真让人惊讶！我从没

好吧，我就信你了，欢迎

scripts.text:

As part of the ceremony of
adulthood, all Utans have to do
a bungee jump. When I grow up,
I'm gonna do it too, and prove
to everybody that I am a man!
scripts.translation:

作为成年礼的一部分，所有的乌坦人
都必须进行一次蹦极。等我长大了，
我也要去做，向所有人证明
我是一个男子汉！

scripts.text:
[Weitan]
I too did the bungee jump when I
was young. I remember it well...
It was my first time, and the
ground rushed up to meet me...
For a moment, I thought I was
going to get myself killed...
scripts.translation:
[韦坦]
我年轻的时候也做过蹦极。
我记忆犹新……
那是我的第一次，地面仿佛
向我扑面而来……
那一瞬间，我以为自己
要没命了……

scripts.text:
[Weitan]
But after I made it, I was so
proud of myself~
Some Utans may not agree, but
I think bungee jumping is an
important part of the ceremony
of adulthood.
scripts.translation:
[韦坦]
但成功之后，我感到非常
自豪~
也许有些乌坦人并不认同，
但我认为蹦极是成年礼中
非常重要的一部分。

scripts.text:
[Jooltan]
It's been a long time since I last
saw a Rune-Midgartsian~!
Welcome, stranger.
scripts.translation:
[祖尔坦]
好久没见到卢恩·米德加兹人
了~！
欢迎你，陌生人。

scripts.text:
[Jooltan]
We Utans use this place for
bungee jumping. Many Utan
youngsters have shown their
bravery, earned their
self-respect, and became
adults in this very place.
scripts.translation:
[祖尔坦]
我们乌坦人把这里当作
蹦极的场所。许多乌坦
青年在这里展现了勇气，
赢得了自尊，并在此地
成为了成年人。

scripts.text:
[Jooltan]
Oh...right. A few unlucky people
just fell and died after
messing up their bungee jump. And
a few had heart attacks while
looking at other people jumping down...
scripts.translation:
[祖尔坦]
噢……对了。有几个倒霉蛋
在玩蹦极的时候失手了，
直接摔死了。还有几个
在看着别人跳下去的时候，
竟然心脏病发作了……

scripts.text:
[Jooltan]
So...
Be careful when you walk around,
You don't want to fall off.
And if you want to try a bungee
jump, you should get yourself ready.
scripts.translation:
[祖尔坦]
所以……
走路的时候小心点，
别不小心掉下去。
如果你想尝试蹦极，
最好先做好心理准备。

scripts.text:
[Jooltan]
Oh...right. Supposedly,
there's an unidentified
creature living in the water...
So if you happen to get dunked,
get out of there~!
scripts.translation:
[祖尔坦]
噢……对了。据说，
水里住着一种未知的
生物……
所以如果你不小心掉进水里，
赶紧逃出来！

scripts.text:
[Mutakutan]
Umbala has many many trees!
I, Mutakutan, like trees so much.
Heh heh~
scripts.translation:
[穆塔库坦]
汶巴拉有很多很多树！
我，穆塔库坦，非常喜欢树。
嘿嘿~

scripts.text:
[Mutakutan]
There is one special tree I like
the most! That is the oldest and
biggest tree in Umbala!
No wait, I think it is the oldest
and biggest in the world...
I'm sure it is!
scripts.translation:
[穆塔库坦]
我最喜欢一棵特别的树！
那是汶巴拉里最古老、
最大的树！
不对，我觉得它是世界上
最古老、最大的树……
我肯定没错！

scripts.text:
[Mutakutan]
It's really really big and old!
It's so tall, even I haven't seen
the top of this tree yet. I tried
climbing it before, but I could
never reach the top...even though
I'm great at tree climbing.
scripts.translation:
[穆塔库坦]
它真的非常非常巨大且古老！
它长得那么高，连我都还没
见过树顶呢。我以前试过
爬那棵树，但怎么也爬不到
顶端……虽然我可是个
爬树高手。

scripts.text:
[Mutakutan]
Oh, also the fruits from the tree
are very tasty! I bet they are the
most delicious fruit in the world~
Sweet and sour...eating it just
makes you feel refreshed and
invigorated~!
scripts.translation:
[穆塔库坦]
噢，而且那棵树结出的果实
也非常美味！我敢打赌，
它们是世界上最美味的果实~
酸酸甜甜的……吃完之后
会让人感到神清气爽，
充满活力~！

scripts.text:
[Mutakutan]
There's an amazing story about
this fruit. An old man in my
village was suffering from a
mortal disease...nothing
seemed to help...
scripts.translation:
[穆塔库坦]
关于这种果实还有一个神奇的
故事。我村子里有个老人，
当时患上了绝症……
什么药似乎都没用……

scripts.text:
[Mutakutan]
But after he took medicine made
from the ground leaves of this
tree, he became healthy and sound
again! I think God sent us the
tree to bless us.
scripts.translation:
[穆塔库坦]
但在他吃了用这棵树的
落叶制成的药之后，
他重新变得健康强壮了！
我觉得是神把这棵树
送来祝福我们的。

scripts.text:
[Mutakutan]
It's at north of my village, so
why don't you go see the greatness
of this tree for yourself?
scripts.translation:
[穆塔库坦]
它就在我村子的北边，
你要不要亲自去看看
这棵树的伟力？
